$comment: Runtime budget for e2e/desktop/runtime.ts --budget. Timings and CPU depend on the machine, so each entry is for one reference machine, keyed by platform-arch. win32-x64 is the Windows Server 2025 build machine without a GPU (the home screen's video is composited in software, which is most of the idle CPU), measured 2026-10-15 on 16 launches: no launch stuck on the splash, main window at 5.3 s fresh and 9.3 s warm (medians), 729 MiB private memory on the home screen after a minute, 94 CPU-s over an idle minute, 21 requests per idle minute. Each slimming stage lowers these.
